name: alpha-sys-1-3B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-3B: 8 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 64) and 22 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-03. A finetune of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-VL-3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.123 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-09-20. CAVEAT: this is a calibration result, not an accuracy one. Every winning row is NLL/Brier on an environment the LoRA was trained on; on the two unseen tasks the untuned base wins both (BoolQ NLL 0.405 vs base+T 0.393; Yelp 0.973 vs 0.961), which is the leave-one-domain-out failure the card itself documents. The comparison is against 'base + T': the untuned LFM2.5-VL-3B with one scalar temperature fitted on each environment's development split, a fairer baseline than the raw base but still a dev-fitted one. Checkpoint 260920 is seed 1 of 3. As a decision model it returns probabilities over a fixed answer set in one forward pass and generates no text, so its NLL rows are not comparable to generative benchmark scores.
